paths.name: Server Data
paths.description: Server data and addons/configuration files will be stored here.

ports.name: Game Port
ports.description: Port used by clients connecting to the server. If this is changed, all of the ports below will need to be recalculated.

ports.name: Query Port 1
ports.description: Port used by clients querying server info. (Game Port + 1)

ports.name: Query Port 2
ports.description: Port used by clients querying server info. (Game Port + 2)

ports.name: GameSpy Query Port 1
ports.description: Port used for querying more detailed server information. (Game Port + 3)

ports.name: GameSpy Query Port 2
ports.description: Port used for querying more detailed server information. (Game Port + 4)

ports.name: LAN Query Port
ports.description: Port used for queries by LAN clients. (Game Port + 1000)

variables.name: Game Type
variables.description: Initial game type to be loaded.

variables.name: Mutators
variables.description: Mutators you want to load, separated by comma (no spaces). For example: MapVoteLA13.BDBMapVote,WhoPushedMe.WhoPushedMe

variables.name: Server Start Extras
variables.description: If you need to add any other parameters to the server launch command, put them in this variable. This must start with a question mark (?), as it will be appended to the end of the mutators list in the built server start command.

variables.name: Server Start Command
variables.description: If you don't want to use the environment variables to specify map/gametype/mutators/extras, you can just specify the entire server start command here. All of the map/gametype/mutators/extras environment variables will be ignored.

variables.name: PUID
variables.description: User ID to run the container as.

variables.name: PGID
variables.description: Group ID to run the container as.

variables.name: Skip Install
variables.description: If you don't want to download/update your server files, set this to true. I assume you know what you're doing. Maybe manually installing your own server to the /data/server directory or something? I don't know.
